component.name: CardBuilder
component.summary: Design business cards, greeting cards, game cards and more

description.p: Design cards of every kind — business cards, ID and gift cards, playing and trading cards, postcards and invitations, folded greeting cards, tent and place cards, bookmarks and tags — with a live 3D preview in real card stocks, foil and spot UV, QR codes, batch cards from a spreadsheet, and print-ready vector PDFs with crop marks and double-sided imposition.
